headline: 4 Industrial Dividend Growers That Fly Under the Radar and Look Like Buys in August
summary: Four industrial names with decades of uninterrupted dividend growth sit largely ignored while yield-seekers chase REITs and telecoms, and their free cash flow coverage ratios tell a story the crowd keeps missing.
